# prime-buttongroup

prime-rs: ButtonGroup component (port of PrimeNG)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/buttongroup) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-buttongroup)

ButtonGroup — port of `p-buttongroup` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Instead of the host `<p-buttongroup>` a `<span class="p-buttongroup p-component" role="group">` is rendered
with projected buttons. The joined look (a shared border, rounded corners only on the outer buttons) is set by the theme CSS.
The `/* For PrimeNG */` block from `buttongroupstyle.ts` targets the `p-button` hosts and is not needed here.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_buttongroup::ButtonGroup;

let html = view! { <ButtonGroup><button class="p-button">"A"</button><button class="p-button">"B"</button></ButtonGroup> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-buttongroup p-component") && html.contains(r#"role="group""#));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-buttongroup = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["buttongroup"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
